overview: The opening night of the 2024 Medford Jazz Festival featured performances by two local jazz ensembles and the announcement of a new fundraising initiative to support local musicians.

items.title: Local Music Initiative and Fundraising
items.summary: Elton announced a $15,000 fundraising campaign to establish a music rehearsal room and pay local musicians for community performances.

items.title: Festival Acknowledgments
items.summary: Jonathan Fagan recognized the student volunteers, sponsors, and municipal organizations, including the Medford Arts Council, that supported the event.

items.title: Morningside Music Studio All-Stars
items.summary: The ensemble performed a set of jazz standards and compositions by Jim Rotondi, Wayne Shorter, and Kenny Barron.

items.title: Intermission Jam Session
items.summary: Festival organizers and audience members held an informal jam session featuring standard repertoire during the intermission.

items.title: Achilles Heal Saxophone Quartet
items.summary: The quartet performed a series of original compositions and arrangements by ensemble members Kathy Olson and Rick Stone, as well as several guest composers.

items.title: Closing and Weekend Outlook
items.summary: Fagan provided details for the remainder of the festival weekend at the West Medford Community Center and solicited donations to sustain the program.
